theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_rps_submanifold_subset_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G M : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : ℤ) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → m ≠ 0 → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → IsOrientation n M ξ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ G → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ G → T ω = m * ∫ x in M, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → M ∩ G ⊆ T.support
